reading_note: The teaching names the two essentials that constitute every spiritual state from its origin: the good-and-truth that flows in from the Lord, and the evil-and-falsity that arises from self-love. The arc moves from a header announcing these two essences, to their identification (Light/Darkness, beautiful/bitter, life/death), to the operative work that follows from knowing them — the separation of good from evil, which is the whole work of regeneration and judgment.

segments.spiritual_sense: The fullness of doctrine concerning the two essentials.

key_correspondences.spiritual: completeness of the teaching about the two opposites
